ga_settings.migration_note: Island model: each process runs one instruction and, at every generation barrier, 05_sync_island.py publishes this island's candidates and pools from its peers the traffic contexts whose control run finished at fitness 0 in every repetition. The island then mates migration_count fewer offspring and gives the free slots to the imports, so nothing already bred is discarded. migration_selection picks which pooled contexts take those slots: 'random' draws uniformly, 'nearest' takes the ones closest in normalized gene space to this island's surviving population, 'positive_instruction' keeps only the contexts whose instruction run itself scored above 0 and draws uniformly from those -- it imports nothing in a generation where no pooled context qualifies, rather than falling back to a uniform draw. reuse_migrant_baseline says whether an imported context adopts the source island's baseline measurement instead of simulating its own control run. These three keys only apply when run_pipeline.py is given --island-index; without it the search runs alone and step 02 reports them as unused. Set migration_count to 0 to run an island without importing anything.
